title: Lubricant R&D bench (test stand) registration
description: Bench resource object (WP-05). A bench is shared test-stand capacity, not a chain stage: it records when it is available, how long one run occupies it, and what one run costs. `available_bench_slots` is DERIVED from availability_window and cycle_days by the single conversion in skills/bench-registration/scripts/bench_policy.py (`available_bench_slots`); the WP-04b/doe_input.resource_envelope.bench_slots must be cross-checked against this same figure (end-to-end linkage recorded as a TODO in tests/lubricant_e2e/test_application_bench.py).

project_reference.description: Project this registration is made for; also used as the artifact project_id by the builder.

cycle_days.description: Wall-clock days one run occupies the bench (changeover included). Strictly positive.

available_bench_slots.description: DERIVED, never hand-set: floor(usable_days(window) / cycle_days) summed over availability_window, where usable_days = (end - start).days + 1 - reserved_days (clamped at 0). Recomputed and asserted by validate_bench_artifact.py.

reserved_days.description: Maintenance/blackout days inside the window that cannot host a run. Optional; treated as 0 when absent.
